# Rayan Idrees (Kactusman) - Detailed AI Knowledge File

## Overview
Rayan Idrees is a Senior CMS Architect and Frontend Specialist with over 4 years of experience building high-traffic production websites, headless ecommerce platforms, and bespoke web applications.

## Technical Work History
- **Senior CMS Developer** at Turn Up Technologies (June 2025 - Present): Architecting multi-platform CMS solutions across WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Framer, Wix, and Squarespace with custom PHP/Liquid APIs and JS runtime hooks.
- **Senior CMS Developer (Lead)** at TechBlent (2023 - May 2025): Led developer teams delivering headless storefronts and enterprise custom WordPress builds for international clients.
- **Frontend Developer** at Lime Software Logics (2023): Developed React components, Tailwind UI components, and dynamic PHP frontend modules.
- **Frontend Developer** at Saazsol (2022 - 2023): Built component libraries and full-stack React/PHP web solutions.
